contract.weight: each completed source-cell sums to one
contract.objective: SUM of source-cell-weighted negative Bernoulli log likelihood + 0.5 SUM squared standardized nonintercept coefficients
contract.constraint: D1/D2 LPIPS<=0; D2 PSNR,SSIM>=0; D3 unrestricted
contract.optimizer: cyclic coordinate Newton with backtracking, KKT tolerance 1e-8, maximum 2000 passes
contract.logsnr: DDIM 1000 linear betas .00085 to .012, inclusive product through start 51/151/351
